task: unchanged finite_study.build_problem; fixed external score; action mixture outside CE
model_information: all methods receive the same frozen per-row empirical outcome law and known state/action support; no true probabilities enter fitting or stopping
primary: empirical Bellman optimization gap to same-bank DP; independently evaluated true recursive utility
decomposition: true DP-minus-actor = empirical optimization gap - DP model optimism + actor model optimism
cost: all 7936 acquired transitions per bank plus actual training CPU/wall and conditional action-value backup counts; evaluation instrumentation reported separately
inference_scope: heldout independent sample banks on the same synthetic task, not independent tasks or cross-domain evidence; no economic cost calibration or sample-complexity claim
prior_diagnostic: 1701 original actor was inspected for occupancy decay and root residual; no candidate algorithm run before this protocol
